subject: spanish
title: Stamp 1: The Subjuntivo
welcome_lead: Stamp your mastery of the Spanish subjunctive mood.
meta_desc: A-Level Spanish adventure on the subjuntivo: present, imperfect, and perfect forms.

concepts.def: Mood expressing doubt, emotion, desire, or subjective views; typically after que.
Present subjunctive: stem changes -ar to -e endings, -er/-ir to -a endings.
Imperfect subjunctive: two interchangeable forms (-ra / -se), formed from the 3rd-person plural preterite.
Perfect subjunctive: haya + past participle. Que haya hablado.
Triggers: ojala, espero que, dudo que, antes de que, para que.
Indicative states facts; subjunctive expresses non-realities, hypotheses, or feelings about facts.

walkthroughs.body_html: For -ar verbs use -e endings; for -er/-ir use -a endings. Hablar: hable, hables, hable, hablemos, hableis, hablen. Comer: coma, comas, coma, comamos, comais, coman.
Take 3rd-person plural preterite, drop -ron, add -ra (or -se) endings. Hablaron to hablara/hablase. Tuvieron to tuviera/tuviese.

After expressions of desire (quiero que), emotion (me alegra que), doubt (dudo que), or impersonal opinion (es importante que). Also after temporal conjunctions referring to future events: cuando llegues.

Hable
Hablare
Hablase

mcqs.q: Which mood follows 'Espero que' (I hope that)?
options: Indicative - 'Espero que tienes éxito'.
Present - 'Hace sol'.
Infinitive.
Subjunctive - 'Espero que tengas éxito'.

mcqs.q: How do you describe weather during a past holiday: 'It was sunny'?
options: Present - 'Hace sol'.
Infinitive.
Preterite - 'Hizo sol' (suggests a completed event).
Imperfect - 'Hacía sol' (descriptive ongoing state).

mcqs.q: Which mood follows 'quiero que' (I want that)?
options: Indicative.
Present - 'Hace sol'.
Subjunctive.
Infinitive.
